hebrewText: וְ/אֵ֣לֶּה מַלְכֵ֣י הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִכּ֤וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַ/יִּֽרְשׁ֣וּ אֶת אַרְצָ֔/ם בְּ/עֵ֥בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֖ן מִזְרְחָ֣/ה הַ/שָּׁ֑מֶשׁ מִ/נַּ֤חַל אַרְנוֹן֙ עַד הַ֣ר חֶרְמ֔וֹן וְ/כָל הָ/עֲרָבָ֖ה מִזְרָֽחָ/ה

tokens.bdb: these or those
tokens.kjv: an-(the) other; one sort, so, some, such, them, these (same), they, this, those, thus, which, who(-m).
tokens.explanation: these or those

tokens.bdb: a king
tokens.kjv: king, royal.
tokens.explanation: melek — rei, governante, soberano de um povo ou nação

tokens.bdb: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] common, country, earth, field, ground, land, [idiom] natins, way, [phrase] wilderness, world.
tokens.explanation: eretz — terra, solo, país, região, toda a terra

tokens.bdb: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.
tokens.explanation: asher — pronome relativo: que, quem, o qual, cujo

tokens.bdb: to strike (lightly or severely, literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: beat, cast forth, clap, give (wounds), [idiom] go forward, [idiom] indeed, kill, make (slaughter), murderer, punish, slaughter, slay(-er, -ing), smite(-r, -ing), strike, be stricken, (give) stripes, [idiom] surely, wound.
tokens.explanation: to strike (lightly or severely

tokens.bdb: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
tokens.kjv: [phrase] afflicted, age, (Ahoh-) (Ammon-) (Hachmon-) (Lev-) ite, (anoint-) ed one, appointed to, ([phrase]) arrow, (Assyr-) (Babylon-) (Egypt-) (Grec-) ian, one born, bough, branch, breed, [phrase] (young) bullock, [phrase] (young) calf, [idiom] came up in, child, colt, [idiom] common, [idiom] corn, daughter, [idiom] of first, [phrase] firstborn, foal, [phrase] very fruitful, [phrase] postage, [idiom] in, [phrase] kid, [phrase] lamb, ([phrase]) man, meet, [phrase] mighty, [phrase] nephew, old, ([phrase]) people, [phrase] rebel, [phrase] robber, [idiom] servant born, [idiom] soldier, son, [phrase] spark, [phrase] steward, [phrase] stranger, [idiom] surely, them of, [phrase] tumultuous one, [phrase] valiant(-est), whelp, worthy, young (one), youth.
tokens.explanation: ben — filho, descendente, membro de um grupo (bar em aramaico)

tokens.bdb: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
tokens.kjv: Israel.
tokens.explanation: Yisrael — nome dado a Jacó (aquele que luta com Deus)

tokens.bdb: to occupy (by driving out previous tenants, and possessing in their place); by implication, to seize, to rob, to inherit; also to expel, to impoverish, to ruin
tokens.kjv: cast out, consume, destroy, disinherit, dispossess, drive(-ing) out, enjoy, expel, [idiom] without fail, (give to, leave for) inherit(-ance, -or) [phrase] magistrate, be (make) poor, come to poverty, (give to, make to) possess, get (have) in (take) possession, seize upon, succeed, [idiom] utterly.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to occupy (by driving out previous tenants
tokens.enLiteralWord: to occupy (by driving out previous tenants
tokens.explanation: to occupy (by driving out previous tenants
tokens.explanationEn: to occupy (by driving out previous tenants

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] common, country, earth, field, ground, land, [idiom] natins, way, [phrase] wilderness, world.
tokens.explanation: eretz — terra, solo, país, região, toda a terra

tokens.bdb: properly, a region across; but used only adverbially (with or without a preposition) on the opposite side (especially of the Jordan; ususally meaning the east)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] against, beyond, by, [idiom] from, over, passage, quarter, (other, this) side, straight.
tokens.explanation: properly

tokens.bdb: Jarden, the principal river of Palestine
tokens.kjv: Jordan.
tokens.explanation: Jarden

tokens.bdb: sunrise, i.e. the east
tokens.kjv: east (side, -ward), (sun-) rising (of the sun).
tokens.explanation: sunrise

tokens.bdb: the sun; by implication, the east; figuratively, a ray, i.e. (architectural) a notched battlement
tokens.kjv: [phrase] east side(-ward), sun (rising), [phrase] west(-ward), window. See also H1053 (בֵּית שֶׁמֶשׁ).
tokens.explanation: the sun; by implication

tokens.bdb: a stream, especially a winter torrent; (by implication) a (narrow) valley (in which a brook runs); also a shaft (of a mine)
tokens.kjv: brook, flood, river, stream, valley.
tokens.explanation: a stream

tokens.bdb: the Arnon, a river east of the Jordan, also its territory
tokens.kjv: Arnon.
tokens.explanation: the Arnon

tokens.bdb: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
tokens.kjv: against, and, as, at, before, by (that), even (to), for(-asmuch as), (hither-) to, [phrase] how long, into, as long (much) as, (so) that, till, toward, until, when, while, ([phrase] as) yet.
tokens.explanation: as far (or long

tokens.bdb: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
tokens.kjv: hill (country), mount(-ain), [idiom] promotion.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a mountain or range of hills
tokens.enLiteralWord: a mountain or range of hills
tokens.explanation: a mountain or range of hills
tokens.explanationEn: a mountain or range of hills

tokens.bdb: Chermon, a mount of Palestine
tokens.kjv: Hermon.
tokens.explanation: Chermon

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).
tokens.explanation: kol — todo, toda, qualquer, totalidade de algo

tokens.bdb: a desert; especially (with the article prefix) the (generally) sterile valley of the Jordan and its continuation to the Red Sea
tokens.kjv: Arabah, champaign, desert, evening, heaven, plain, wilderness. See also H1026 (בֵּית הָעֲרָבָה).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a desert; especially  the  sterile valley of the Jordan and its continuation to the Red Sea
tokens.enLiteralWord: a desert; especially  the  sterile valley of the Jordan and its continuation to the Red Sea
tokens.explanation: a desert; especially  the  sterile valley of the Jordan and its continuation to the Red Sea
tokens.explanationEn: a desert; especially  the  sterile valley of the Jordan and its continuation to the Red Sea

tokens.bdb: sunrise, i.e. the east
tokens.kjv: east (side, -ward), (sun-) rising (of the sun).
tokens.explanation: sunrise
